props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Content rendered inside the list when the collection is empty.

props.name: items
props.description: Reactive collection rendered by the list.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called when a drag moves a row to a new index.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Lets users reorder rows by dragging. Update `items` from `onReorder`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: Renders only the visible items. The list root is the scroll container.
